senses.gloss: (transpos. of קלף; cmp. Syr. קפל, P. Sm. 3691, sq.) to scrape, eat away.
units: <cite ref="Sifrei Bamidbar 85">Sifré Num. 85</cite> [read:] <he>ירדה … קוֹפֶלֶת ומחתה בהם מתחתיהם</he> fire came down from heaven, and it was eating away and digging among them from under them; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 732">Yalk. ib. 732</cite> [read:] <he>קופלת ומחתה בהם</he>.

<cite ref="Moed Katan 9b:13">M. Kat. 9ᵇ</cite> <he>בסיד … לקַפְּלוֹ במועד</he> a lime paste which you may scrape off during the festive week.—[<cite ref="Sotah 35b">Sot. 35ᵇ</cite>, Rashi to <cite ref="Chullin 44a">Ḥull. 44ᵃ</cite> <he>וקפלו את האבנים</he>, ‘they scraped the stones’ by confounding with <cite ref="Chullin 36a">ib. 36ᵃ</cite> <he>וקילפו את הסיד</he>.]

senses.gloss: to be scraped; (of glassware) to be cut or engraven. Y. Succ. IV, 54ᵈ top מהו … שהיתה מִתְקַפֶּלֶת what kind of white glass is meant? Cut (or engraved) glass.
